messages:
maria: Heads up — linux-fast CI blew up on main after merge of PR #7482. Failing test: test_package_install. Rolling reruns don't help, fails consistently on the same job.

kevin: re-run links? which job?

maria: job: linux-fast / ubuntu-22.04 / package-install-3. Logs show linker error during packaging step. Last green was at commit a1b2c3d4 (2026-03-14). First bad at HEAD (commit f5e6d7c8).

aj: can you paste the tail of the log?

maria: ```
--- FAIL: test_package_install (0.12s)
packager: /usr/bin/ld: skipping incompatible /opt/local/lib/libfoo.a when searching for -lfoo
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status

--- FAIL DETAILS ---
cmd: /build/packager --out pkg.tar.gz
exit code: 1
```

ci-bot: build linux-fast #4578 — failed — https://ci.internal/reports/4578

kevin: that ld error smells like a toolchain swap or changed build flags. PR 7482 touched the Dockerfile for the build image, right?

maria: yes PR 7482 bumped base image from ubuntu:22.04 to ubuntu:24.04-beta and added a multilib shim. I suspect the shim broke 32/64-bit arch linkage.

aj: ok can someone bisect between a1b2c3d4 (good) and f5e6d7c8 (bad)? I can do the git side but not push changes to CI images. If it's image-related we might need a quick revert or roll-forward to fix.

maria: I kicked off a local bisect attempt but CI-only failures are noisy. Steps I propose:
1) git bisect start --bad f5e6d7c8 --good a1b2c3d4
2) for each candidate, run `./scripts/ci/build-packager-image.sh` to build the image locally then run `./scripts/test/run.sh test_package_install`
3) if local reproduces, open short revert PR for culprit commit.

kevin: also check the image diffs: `docker history --no-trunc <image>` and `docker run --rm <image> dpkg -l | grep -E 'binutils|ld|glibc'` — maybe a package upgrade changed behaviour.

aj: I'll take the bisect on my laptop, but I might need a CI artifact of the failing image to test quickly. maria can you upload the failing image tarball from the CI node?

maria: uploading now to //artifacts/ci/4578/linux-image.tar.gz (will take ~3m) :hourglass:

ci-bot: artifact uploaded: //artifacts/ci/4578/linux-image.tar.gz

aj: thanks. Starting bisect now. If I find a single commit that introduces it, I'll post the SHA and suggested revert.

(25 minutes later)

aj: quick update — bisect points to commit 3f4e5d6a which is the image bump introduced in PR 7482. Locally reproduces when using the ubuntu:24.04-beta base.

kevin: good catch. What's the minimal fix — pin glibc/binutils back or remove multilib shim?

aj: quick mitigation: revert the bump in the Dockerfile so CI uses the previous base. I'll prepare a revert PR (small change). If we want to keep the bump, we should test image-level package compatibility in a staging pipeline first.

maria: please tag me in the PR and request a fast-track merge + release to Dedicated canary.

aj: PR opened: #7510 — revert image bump (diff is one line). requesting urgent review.

kevin: reviewing now. If approved I'll merge and trigger a redeploy of linux-fast. :thumbsup:

maria: after revert merges, I'll re-run the failed job and confirm green. If green, we'll schedule a proper image upgrade with compatibility checks.

ci-bot: build linux-fast #4581 — queued (triggered by PR #7510)

(1 hour later)

ci-bot: build linux-fast #4581 — passed

maria: confirmed — test_package_install passed on #4581. Marking this resolved for now. We'll do follow-up to make image upgrades safer.

kevin: nice end-to-end. Follow-up items: add an image-compatibility job in CI + add a short checklist for base-image bumps. I'll file a ticket.

aj: filed infra ticket INF-328: image upgrade compatibility gating.

maria: thanks everyone :tada:
